description: This Java class 'LayoutAnimations' demonstrates how to use Android's LayoutTransition to animate addition, removal, and changing of views within a container layout. It provides customizable transition animations and handles user interactions through UI controls such as buttons and checkboxes.

classes.name: LayoutAnimations
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating layout transition animations using LayoutTransition and ObjectAnimator, with UI controls to customize and trigger animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and configures UI interactions for controlling animations.

methods.name: setupTransition
methods.description: Configures the LayoutTransition object with suitable Animators based on user-selected options.

methods.name: createCustomAnimations
methods.description: Creates custom Animator objects for different transition effects like changing appearance/disappearance and adding/removing views.
